summary: Only six word orders exist and each input has at most 100 characters, so the total legal string domain is too tight for honest asymptotic timing; exhaustive oracle and boundary evidence verify the overlap enumeration.

workload_bound.source_constraint: each of a, b, and c has length between 1 and 100

replacement_checks.evidence: There are exactly six permutations. Each performs two merges, and each merge checks containment plus at most L suffix-prefix comparisons.
Regression compares all triples over {a,b} of length at most two with an exhaustive generated-string oracle and checks containment, cyclic overlap, ties, duplicates, and 100-character boundaries.
